# clap 4.6.7 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/clap (published 2026-09-14)
- docs: https://docs.rs/clap/4.6.7/clap/
- repo: https://github.com/clap-rs/clap
- license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
- rust-version: 1.85; edition 2024

## Install

```toml
clap = { version = "4.6.7", features = ["derive", "env"] }
```

`env` is not a default feature. `#[arg(env = "MSN_…")]` reads the variable only when the flag is absent (flags override env). `hide_env_values = true` keeps token values out of help. `#[command(name = "msn", version, after_help = EXAMPLES)]` sets the binary name independently of package `msn-cli` and prints `--version` from `CARGO_PKG_VERSION`. Subcommands via `#[derive(Subcommand)]`. Parse errors: clap exit 2; `--help`/`--version` exit 0.

Rejected: argh 0.1.19 (no env fallback, no `--version`, no `hide_env_values`).
